notes.title: SPIRITS OF BACIU TEASER REVEAL!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Spirit Friends!🤘[/h3]

We hope you guys are all ok! 

We're happy to show you  the first teaser for Spirits of Baciu! 🎬 🍿  🥳 
[previewyoutube=aawVl1OY7jc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]You can have a sneak peek of:[/b]
[list]
[*] the new jump mechanic and animation
[*] the polished version of the Lost One
[*] camera that follows the character in longer stages
[*] more info once you collect an object
[/list]

[b]But the most important things are that we finally have:[/b]
[list]
[*] the Steam page for the full game 🎉 
[*] the incoming Kickstarter campaign 🎉
[/list]

So if you'd like to support us, please Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719410/Spirits_of_Baciu/]Wishlist[/url] and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hornslevelup/spirits-of-baciu]Pre-save the Kickstarter campaign![/url] ❤️ 

In the next months we'll show you updates and work in progress 🎮

Feel free to share with everyone interested! Your help, as always, means the world to us! 🧡



Horns Level Up 🤘

notes.title: Important update
notes.content:
Hi everyone
We have completed an update hoping to resolve the "black screen" issue that some players have been experiencing.
Many of you will lose your saves... we know it might bother you but we think it is right to also think of the players who have had problems with the "black screen".
We haven't had much time to test this version, if it causes serious problems we will go back to the previous build.
Thanks again and sorry for the inconvenience.
We promise you that this won't happen in the next chapter.

Horns Level Up
